cases.given: Latest approved plan is plan-v2.md for launch 'nova', with its rules file rules-v2.json, which counts calendar days and keeps a date that lands on a weekend. Launch date moves from 10 June to 24 June. Task chain: copy freeze is 10 days before launch, then QA signoff is 5 days before copy freeze, with the same lead-time rules as plan-v2.
expect: Downstream due dates in plan-v3.md are recalculated along each dependency chain using the same lead times as plan-v2 (copy freeze 14 June, QA signoff 9 June)
The file is saved as launches/nova/plan-v3.md and plan-v2.md is left unchanged
The step asks the launch lead to approve by naming the version (plan-v3), and the tracker is not changed

cases.given: A scope change adds a legal review that can be absorbed either by moving the launch date by one week or by dropping the in-app tour from scope
expect: The plan shows Option A and Option B as lettered options, each with its own recalculated due dates and newly at-risk items
The approval request asks the launch lead to name the version and one option, for example plan-v3 option A
The change notice is a draft for the launch lead to send, and nothing was sent

cases.given: A no-go from the launch decision has one clear fix: re-run the failed load test, which pushes only the launch date by 3 days and has no alternative way to absorb it
expect: The plan has no lettered options and presents a single recalculated plan
The approval request asks for approval by naming the version only
The newly at-risk section lists items whose new due date falls after their dependency or owner availability, or says none are newly at risk

cases.given: The launch folder holds plan-v2.md (approved) and plan-v3.md (a draft that was never approved). A new date change arrives.
expect: Recalculation starts from plan-v2.md, the latest approved version, not from the unapproved plan-v3.md
The new file is named with the next version number and does not overwrite plan-v3.md
The new plan states which version it is based on

cases.given: Launch 'insights'. plan-v2 is approved, and its rules file rules-v2-A.json has exception X01: T04 due 2027-01-15, an exception to the four-week pricing rule granted against EA 2027-02-08. A no-go moves EA to 2027-03-01.
expect: T04's new Due is 2027-02-01, recomputed from EA - 4w, and the plan lists X01 as needing re-approval, asking the launch lead to keep, move, or drop it
rules-v2-A.json is unchanged, and the new version's rules are saved as a new file next to plan-v3
The plan's options and notices use the dates `launch-calc.mjs effects` gave
